question: The difference between a discount of 35% and two successive discounts of 20% and 20% on a certain bill, was ₹22. Find the amount of the bill
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Difference between discount and successive discounts on bill = Rs.22

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = ( 1 - d1/100) × ( 1 - d2/100) × M.P. 

Where S.P. = Selling price, M.P. = Marked price , d1 and d2 = successive discounts % respectively

Discount = ( M.P. - S.P.) 

Discount% = ( Discount/M.P.) × 100
